description: Dijken wegdorp is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Dijk- en wegdorpen komen in heel Zeeland voor en zijn niet zoals het ringdorp en het voorstraatdorp voornamelijk gerelateerd aan het oud- of nieuwland. Dijkdorpen zoals de naam al zegt zijn ontstaan langs dijken en wegdorpen langs (een kruising van) wegen. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are cultuurhistorie, langs--een-kruising-van--wegen, langs-dijken, nederzettingstypen. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-08-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
